title: [PC] Hogwarts Legacy 1080p Ultra RX 6700 XT Benchmark Performance Analysis
description:
In this video we take a look at how the RX 6700 XT handles Hogwarts Legacy at native 1080p as well as with FSR 2 and XeSS. All video footage was encoded using the built-in H.265 AMF encoder on the 6700 XT.

Test PC
OS: Windows 10 Pro 22H2
CPU: Ryzen 9 7950X3d - https://amzn.to/3N6ytf3
Cooler: Noctua NH-D15 - https://amzn.to/3MXEjzh
Motherboard: Gigabyte X670E AORUS Master - https://amzn.to/43jwxpm
RAM: G.Skill Ripjaws V 64gb 5600mhz 2x32gb - https://amzn.to/3WE1HVJ
PSU: MEG Ai1300P PCIE5 PSU - https://amzn.to/43r6Wdx
GPU: Radeon RX 7900 XTX - https://amzn.to/3WLQYbO
Case: Fractal Torrent RGB - https://amzn.to/45rlGex


Recommended/High Specs System Requirements
OS: Windows 10 64-bit
CPU: AMD Ryzen 7 5800X or Intel i7-11700k
RAM: 32 GB
GPU: AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT or Nvidia Geforce 1080 Ti or Intel ARC A770
DirectX Version: 12
Storage: 85 GB SSD
